Control.name: KPUI_PreviousListings
Control.OnInitialized:
self.SetPreviousListings = function(listingItemsTable, lastControl)
--local kelaPlayerAccountName = GetUnitDisplayName('player')
for i = 1, 5 do local row = GetControl(self:GetName().."row"..i) if row then row:SetHidden(true) end end
self:GetNamedChild("Header"):GetNamedChild("Title"):SetText(GetString(KELA_SETTING_TRADE_TOOLTIP_LISTINGS)) self:GetNamedChild("Header"):GetNamedChild("TitleValue"):SetText(" ") self:GetNamedChild("Header"):GetNamedChild("Guild"):SetText(GetString(KELA_TRADING_TRADING_GUILD)) self:GetNamedChild("Header"):GetNamedChild("Result"):SetText(" ") self:GetNamedChild("Header"):GetNamedChild("Period"):SetText(GetString(KELA_TRADING_PERIOD)) self:GetNamedChild("Header"):GetNamedChild("PriceForOne"):SetText(GetString(KELA_TRADING_PRICE_TITLE)) self:GetNamedChild("Header"):GetNamedChild("PriceForLot"):SetText(GetString(KELA_TRADING_PRICEFORLOT)) self:GetNamedChild("Header"):ClearAnchors() self:GetNamedChild("Header"):SetHidden(false) self:GetNamedChild("Header"):SetAnchor(TOPLEFT, lastControl, BOTTOMLEFT) self:GetNamedChild("Header"):SetAnchor(TOPRIGHT, lastControl, BOTTOMRIGHT) lastControl = self:GetNamedChild("Header")
local count = 0 local isStack for listingTime, listingItem in spairs(listingItemsTable, function (t, a, b) return (a > b) end) do
count = count + 1
local color = ArkadiusTradeTools:GetGuildColor(listingItem["guildName"])
local periodValue if listingItem["period"] then local timeString if listingItem["period"] == 0 then timeString = "-" else timeString = zo_strformat(SI_TRADING_HOUSE_BROWSE_ITEM_REMAINING_TIME, ZO_FormatTime(listingItem["period"], TIME_FORMAT_STYLE_SHOW_LARGEST_UNIT, TIME_FORMAT_PRECISION_SECONDS, TIME_FORMAT_DIRECTION_DESCENDING)) end periodValue = KelaTimeStampToDateTimeString(listingTime).." ("..timeString..")" else local timeString = zo_strformat(SI_TRADING_HOUSE_BROWSE_ITEM_REMAINING_TIME, ZO_FormatTime(GetTimeStamp() - listingTime, TIME_FORMAT_STYLE_SHOW_LARGEST_UNIT, TIME_FORMAT_PRECISION_SECONDS, TIME_FORMAT_DIRECTION_DESCENDING)) periodValue = KelaTimeStampToDateTimeString(listingTime).." ("..timeString..")" end
local row = GetControl(self:GetName().."row"..count) if not row then row = CreateControlFromVirtual("$(parent)row", self, "KPUI_PreviousListingsRow", count) end
row:GetNamedChild("Guild"):SetText(color:Colorize(listingItem["guildName"])) row:GetNamedChild("Result"):SetText(listingItem["result"]) row:GetNamedChild("Period"):SetText(periodValue) row:GetNamedChild("PriceForOne"):SetText(KelaLocalizedFormatNumber(listingItem["desiredPrice"]/listingItem["stackCount"]))
if listingItem["stackCount"] > 1 then row:GetNamedChild("PriceForLot"):SetText(KelaLocalizedFormatNumber(listingItem["desiredPrice"]).." ("..listingItem["stackCount"]..")") isStack = true else row:GetNamedChild("PriceForLot"):SetText("") isStack = false end
row:ClearAnchors() row:SetHidden(false) row:SetAnchor(TOPLEFT, lastControl, BOTTOMLEFT) row:SetAnchor(TOPRIGHT, lastControl, BOTTOMRIGHT)
lastControl = row
if count >= 5 then break end
end
if not isStack then self:GetNamedChild("Header"):GetNamedChild("PriceForLot"):SetText("") end
self:GetNamedChild("Footer"):ClearAnchors() self:GetNamedChild("Footer"):SetAnchor(TOPLEFT, lastControl, BOTTOMLEFT) self:GetNamedChild("Footer"):SetAnchor(TOPRIGHT, lastControl, BOTTOMRIGHT) return self:GetNamedChild("Footer") end
